description: Order-by-order breakdown for a date range — the same rows as Reports → Sales Breakdown. One row per order AND per refund. Answers 'show me the orders from Saturday', 'which order had that big discount', 'how many refunds last month', 'sales per day'. The `totals` and `dailyTrend` in the reply cover the WHOLE date range, not just the returned page — quote them directly instead of adding up rows. For headline figures alone use get_financial_summary; this tool is for when the merchant wants to see the actual orders.

endDate.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Inclusive of the day when a bare date is given

outlets.description: Outlet ids to restrict to. Omit for all outlets

stations.description: Station ids to restrict to. Omit for all stations

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the daily grouping, e.g. "America/Toronto". Defaults to the server timezone

name: hub_get_sales_breakdown
title: Sales breakdown
